§6Machine type: §aAssembly Line§r

Imagination can take you anywhere
The built-in integrated logistics system allows you to no longer worry about external logistics design.
Spatial isolation technology brings higher batch production capabilities.
The cost is 1.5 times the base time.
Still need to use the data access hatch to provide data stick.
The energy hatch tier limits the voltage tier at which recipes can be executed.
Nanite Containment Bus can be installed and provided with silver nanites or gold nanites to increase the running speed.
Up to 256 Silver Nanites will increase the running speed to 100% of normal speed.
Or up to 1024 Gold Nanites will increase the running speed to 200% of normal speed,
And double the parallelism.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Output Hatch, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: Tiered glass (limits the energy hatch tier); Space Elevator casings; the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.

[note]Controller recipe[/note]: Assembly Line (TecTech research), UEV
